result.summary: Found 1 issue: a section heading shows an unresolved localization key instead of user-facing text.

issues.description: The section heading beneath 'Fastest near you' displays the raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a translated title.
issues.suggestion: Provide a translation for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key (e.g., 'Popular near you') and add a fallback so raw keys are never shown to users.
